281478533.description:
This lot contains approximately 30+ raw mineral and rock specimens suitable for collectors and educational purposes. The collection includes various types of quartz crystals, calcite clusters, and other mineral formations. The specimens feature a range of colors including clear, white, gray, brown, green, and yellow. Most pieces are unpolished and display natural surfaces with crystal terminations, druse, and matrix formations visible on many specimens. The stones vary in size and shape. The collection is in good used condition with minor natural imperfections typical of raw mineral specimens. Pieces are suitable for display, study, or lapidary use.
11 Pounds.
*MEASUREMENTS ARE APPROXIMATE
*MAY HAVE FAINT STAINS AND LIGHT WEAR & TEAR THAT CAMERA CANNOT PICK UP
*MAY HAVE SCUFFS AND DEBRIS FROM DONATION/STORAGE
*ALL ITEMS ARE DONATED AND IN USED CONDITION UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED
